title: Rainforest animals
examples: What kinds of animals live in the rainforest?
Can you tell me about the rainforest layers?
Are jaguars big cats or monkeys?

explain.say: Today you will learn about rainforest animals. You will also learn about the layers of the rainforest.
Jaguars are big spotted cats. They live on the rainforest floor.
Brightly coloured parrots fly through the treetops. They make loud calls.
Sloths move very slowly. They hang from branches most of the time.
Tree frogs have smooth, damp skin. Many live on wet leaves.
The rainforest has layers, one above the other. The canopy is a thick layer of leaves near the top.

draw.text: Rainforest layers: the canopy is near the top

faq.q: Do all rainforest animals live only in the rainforest?
faq.a: No, some animals live in other places too. However, the rainforest is their natural home for many species.

faq.q: Are sloths always sleeping in the rainforest?
faq.a: Sloths sleep a lot, and they move slowly. They live in the trees and eat leaves.
asks: Where do sloths prefer to live?

faq.q: What is the difference between the canopy and the understory?
faq.a: The canopy is the thick layer of leaves near the top. The understory is below the canopy, where it is darker.
No, some animals like jaguars have camouflage spots. But parrots and frogs are often very bright.
asks: Can some animals be dull colored?

faq.q: What do jaguars eat in the rainforest?
faq.a: Jaguars are carnivores, which means they eat meat. They hunt other animals that live in the jungle.

facts: Rainforests are very wet and warm places.
The canopy is a thick layer of leaves near the top of the forest.
Jaguars have spotted patterns on their fur.
Parrots use their strong beaks to crack nuts.

quiz.say: Which rainforest animal moves very slowly through the trees?
quiz.why: Sloths move slowly and hang from branches.

wrong.0: A jaguar can run fast on the forest floor.
wrong.1: A parrot flies quickly through the trees.

quiz.say: Parrots fly in the thick layer of leaves near the top. What is it called?
quiz.why: The canopy is the thick layer of leaves near the top of the trees.

wrong.1: The forest floor is the ground, where jaguars walk.

quiz.say: Which rainforest animal is a brightly coloured bird?
quiz.why: Parrots are birds with bright feathers.

wrong.0: A sloth is a slow mammal with fur.
wrong.2: A frog can be bright, but it is an amphibian.
